description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class for an Android TV app, responsible for rendering a vertical list of sections on the home screen, including header, banner, and content rows with nested horizontal recyclers.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing different section types (header, banner, content rows) for the home screen.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for each position based on section item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders corresponding to section types, inflating layouts or creating RecyclerView programmatically.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds section data to corresponding view holders.

inner_classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
inner_classes.description: Handles binding for the header section, including styling brand text and managing focus behavior for the top navigation.

inner_classes.name: BannerSectionVH
inner_classes.description: Manages the banner section that displays horizontally scrollable banners with snapping behavior.

inner_classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
inner_classes.description: Handles binding of individual content rows with horizontal scrolling lists of cards.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders for header, banner, or content row sections, also managing focus behavior.
